headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advises Moneyview on its ₹1,091.68 crore IPO
hook: Law firm advises on a fintech debut
summary: Law firm Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co. acted as legal counsel for Moneyview Limited on its upcoming initial public offering worth ₹1,091.68 crore. The fintech company is preparing to tap the public markets with this primary and secondary share sale. Legal advisories for major IPOs highlight active corporate pipelines in the Indian financial sector. Retail investors tracking new public offerings should review the company's draft red herring prospectus for financials.
why_it_matters: New fintech IPO pipeline expands for retail investors.
